The Kalat Festival is named after a district in Balochistan, previously known as Qalat. The
festival is celebrated every year in October. It has a unique significance since it presents a
much needed opportunity to gather people from around the world and Pakistan to connect
in a peaceful event and explore the hidden treasures of Balochistan and its centuries-old
culture.
The Balochi festival also has the potential to
empower the feelings of brotherhood,
compassion, and love through vibrant colours,
soulful music, and other such festivities. Along
with leaving a lasting impression, the Kalat Festival
also contributes highly towards highlighting the
fact that every human, regardless of all other
factors, want the same things in life: peace,
security, a tune to sing and dance to, and a delicious serving of food.
